# Carnegie Mellon University

> > Carnegie Mellon University is a global research university in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, founded by Andrew Carnegie in 1900, driving innovation in technology, robotics, artificial intelligence, and interdisciplinary research.

CMU operates multiple campuses including facilities at TCS Hall, ANSYS Hall, Tepper Quad, and the National Robotics Engineering Center (NREC) in Lawrenceville and Hazelwood Green. Under President Farnam Jahanian's leadership, the university maintains strong regional partnerships while advancing medical research, entrepreneurship, and civil discourse initiatives.
